plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: A usage bar above the prompt: context fill, 5h/7d quota and cost, with optional git, model and prompt cache segments per environment

plugins.name: repo-sync
plugins.description: Fast-forwards the git repos you list at session start, and tells Claude when an instructions file such as AGENTS.md changed under it

plugins.name: settings-sync
plugins.description: Merges a shared settings file, such as one in a synced git repo, into each machine's settings.json at session start, keeping each machine's own settings

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: One-click compact or handoff to a new session once the context passes a threshold, with summaries saved to disk
